definitions.explanation: A person's official title, rank, or position, especially as used on business cards or in formal introductions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肩書|かたがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put your title on your business card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肩書|かたがき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧だ。
{肩書|かたがき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}して→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't judge people only by their titles.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧ (shoulder) + {書|がき} (writing) — originally referred to text written above a person's name, where titles were placed.

WRITING:
Also written as {肩書|かたがき}き with okurigana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肩書|かたがき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a title
- {肩書|かたがき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about titles
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{肩書|かたがき}: an impressive title

USAGE:
In Japanese business culture, {肩書|かたがき} is important for establishing hierarchy and proper etiquette. Business cards (⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧) always include one's title.
